description: Stream COPC (Cloud Optimized Point Cloud, .copc.laz) files directly into CesiumJS — no pre-tiling, no backend. Synthesises 3D Tiles (tileset.json + .pnts) on the fly inside a Service Worker from HTTP range requests.
rules: cesium is a peer dependency; install it alongside @gyeonghokim/copc-tileset.
Register the Service Worker once at startup with registerCopcServiceWorker(scriptUrl) and await it before creating any primitive — it resolves only when the worker controls the page.
Serve the self-contained worker via the @gyeonghokim/copc-tileset/vite plugin copcServiceWorker() for Vite, or copy it with the `copc-tileset init <public-dir>` CLI for any other bundler.
Open a file with CopcProvider.fromUrl(url, options?), then build the point cloud with CopcPointCloudPrimitive.fromProvider(provider, options?) and add it to viewer.scene.primitives.
The .copc.laz file must be served over HTTP with Range request support and CORS enabled.
The app must be bundled with a tool that supports ?url asset imports (Vite, webpack 5, Parcel, Rspack) so the laz-perf .wasm is emitted.
Use pointCloudShading (attenuation, eyeDomeLighting) for distance-based sizing and EDL; use customShader for attribute-driven colouring (Classification, Intensity, GpsTime).
Never import from cesium in any module reachable from the Service Worker entry point — tile-generation code must stay Cesium-free.
